tools.name: destinations_search
tools.description: Find the destinations SimOptions sells travel eSIMs for, by country or region name in any language, or by code. Returns up to 10 destinations, best match first: each one's code (pass it to plans_find), name, type (country or region), the countries it covers and its page on simoptions.com. A country with no page of its own is answered with the regional plans that cover it.

query.description: Country or region name in any language, or its code: "Japan", "Europe", "JP". At least 2 characters.

tools.name: plans_find
tools.description: List the SimOptions travel eSIM plans in stock for a trip. With one destination code: the plans its page on simoptions.com lists. With several: the plans that cover every one of them. Destination codes come from destinations_search. Optional filters: shortest validity, least data (unlimited plans always qualify), unlimited data only. Cheapest first, at most 20; total says how many matched. Each plan carries its id (EAN), validity, data, networks per country, 5G, calls, SMS, phone number, whether it can be topped up, operator, price in the asked currency, and its page on simoptions.com, where it is bought.

destinations.description: Destination codes from destinations_search ("FR", "EUR"). One code: the plans its page lists. Several: the plans that cover them all.

minDataGb.description: Least data accepted, in GB. Unlimited plans always qualify.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices are in, e.g. "USD" or "EUR". Defaults to the site's own currency.

tools.name: devices_check
tools.description: Check whether a phone or tablet supports eSIM against the compatible-device list simoptions.com publishes, by its model name ("iPhone 15 Pro", "Samsung Galaxy S24") or model code ("SM-S921B"). "yes" names the listed model. "unknown" means it is not on the list, which only holds compatible models: it is not a no, and the phone's settings tell whether it has an eSIM option.

model.description: The phone or tablet: its model name ("iPhone 15 Pro", "Samsung Galaxy S24") or model code ("SM-S921B").
